prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Trait", "Select companion behavior trait"]
1: ["Set Up Daily Companion Habits", "Select your preferred daily interaction times while your pet initializes.", "Choose morning and evening pet check-in times", "Save Schedule"]
2: ["Step-by-step companion trait selector"]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion Workspace", "Learn quick hotkeys to talk to, summon, or hide your desktop pet anytime.", "Master basic desktop pet shortcuts"]
4: ["Signing in automatically locates and restores your previously adopted pets and cloud progress."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Environment", "Initializing desktop pet animations and shortcut listeners."]
6: ["Press Shift+Pet to Toggle Controls & Visibility", "Your companion lives on your desktop. Use quick hotkeys anytime to hide, move, or speak to your pet."]
7: ["Includes Unique Companion Desktop Interaction Perks"]
8: ["Your desktop companion is ready for adoption!"]
9: ["Feel free to use other apps! We will ping your system as soon as your pet is ready."]
